card.name: Re- before initiated after withholding
card.fires_on: The piece "re" right before "initiated" in sentences about how many patients restarted a drug after it was withheld for an adverse reaction. Also the hyphen in "Treatment-Experienced".

modes.label: Restarted after withholding
modes.description: The "re" that begins "reinitiated" after a count of patients whose immunotherapy was withheld for an immune-related reaction.
modes.example: Of the 17 patients in whom OPDIVO with ipilimumab was withheld for hepatitis, 14<< re>>initiated treatment after symptom improvement;

modes.label: Hyphen in treatment-experienced
modes.description: The hyphen joining "Treatment" and "Experienced" in HIV dosing headings.
modes.example: Dosing Recommendations for Treatment-Naïve Pediatric Patients or Antiretroviral Treatment<<->>Experienced Pediatric Patients with No Darun

card.writes: It seems to push toward word beginnings such as "initi" that complete "reinitiated" or similar words.
card.plain: It lights up on the "re" in "reinitiated" when a label says how many patients restarted a drug after it was held.
